criteria.name: Text Type
criteria.feedback: Your essay demonstrates clear organization with a well-structured introduction, body, and conclusion, using appropriate formal language. For an even higher score, you might focus on making transitions and paragraph development more sophisticated.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.feedback: Your essay clearly states one specific improvement and logically explains how it would benefit people your age, with supporting examples; to strengthen your work, provide more detailed analysis of long-term consequences next time.

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.feedback: Your essay presents accurate and logical reasoning about how technology can improve education and job opportunities, but a more nuanced discussion of how technology might affect employment (such as the potential for automation to reduce some jobs) would strengthen your argument further.
